equation_summary: Raven is an external router feeding the exact two-stage GSA mixer. Router logits r_proj(x) (lin or MLP), optional training-time Gumbel noise (subtract log-exponential), orig_scores = sigmoid(router) or softmax(router); topk slot indices over scores (plus optional r_bias); sigmoid case renormalizes selected weights by their sum (+1e-9); a multihot slot vector s_multihot is scattered; decay f = f * s_multihot (f from Mamba2-style -exp(A_log)*softplus(a_proj(x)+dt_bias), or GLA-style logsigmoid(f_proj)/8), then s = 1 - exp(f). These (q,k,v,s,g=f) go into chunk_gsa / fused_recurrent_gsa — the 049 two-stage additive slot-summary + interstage softmax + value-summary call graph unchanged. q,k pass a feature map (swish/relu/t2r) and RMSNorm, optional RoPE; v = gate_fn(v); output gated RMSNorm + o_proj.
state_shape: same as 049 GSA: hk [K,M] and hv [M,V] per head (kv groups repeated across query heads)
gate_scope: channel (per-slot) data-dependent decay; router-selected slots zero the decay contribution elsewhere (f *= s_multihot) so unselected slots get s=0 writes and exp(0)=1 decay — sparse slot selection realized as dense gated GSA
normalization: router: sigmoid+sum-renormalization or softmax; interstage slot softmax inside GSA; FusedRMSNormGated output
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM ledger claim: Raven = E[router/top-k/feature map/decays] ; (049 exact two-stage GSA call graph) ; E[norm/output] — layers/raven.py:265-326 computes router/topk/decays then calls chunk_gsa/fused_recurrent_gsa with s,g exactly as in 049.

CONFIRM 'Source Raven routing and GQA': num_kv_heads/num_kv_groups repetition (raven.py:300-301) and router variants (sigmoid/softmax, lin/mlp, Gumbel noise, bias_rmm) are all external frontend concerns; no core route op is needed since routing only modulates dense gate tensors (f *= s_multihot).
CONFIRM 'no Raven backend path': everything outside fla.ops.gsa is ordinary GEMM/norm/feature-map/scatter ops.
